description: Ingot growth + wafer slicing batch record, emitted by the himawari ingot_wafer cell (fed by polysilicon_refine). Carries the polysilicon lot → wafer batch link (G11 traceability), G5 (kerf-Si recovery, ≥90% circular) + G4 (renewable process energy from hikari only) structural enforcement, and a >=2 robot witness quorum over the slicing QA bundle. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID, and per-lot history is queryable as-of any point. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200.

batchId.description: himawari-assigned ingot/wafer batch identifier; second link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module serial chain (G11 traceability)

polysiliconLotId.description: G11: feedstock lot consumed by this batch; chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.polysiliconProvenanceAttestation.lotId (G2 XUAR-exclusion provenance inherited from the lot)

recordedAt.description: batch attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this batch

ingotMethod.description: ingot growth route; Cz monocrystalline (mono-Si) vs directional-solidification cast multicrystalline (mc-Si)

sliceMethod.description: wafer slicing route; diamond-wire enables cleaner kerf-Si recovery (G5) and lower-toxicity process than slurry

waferCount.description: number of good wafers produced by this batch

waferThicknessUm.description: as-cut wafer thickness (micrometres; integer); thinner = less Si per Wp (G5 material efficiency)

ingotMassKg.description: ingot mass grown from the feedstock lot (kilograms; integer); G5 mass-balance numerator

kerfRecoveredGrams.description: G5: kerf-Si mass recovered from slicing for the circular recycled loop (grams; integer); fed back as recycled-kerf feedstock

kerfRecoveryFractionBps.description: G5: recovered-kerf fraction of total kerf loss, basis points 0-10000 (9000 = 90%; ≥9000 satisfies the ≥90% circular anchor)

processEnergyWh.description: G4: ingot-growth + slicing process energy (Wh; integer); accounted toward EPBT

renewableEnergyFractionBps.description: G4: fraction of process energy from hikari renewable, basis points 0-10000 (10000 = 100%; fossil/nuclear prohibited at any tier)

bomCid.description: G8: per-batch SBOM (CycloneDX → kotoba EAVT, ADR-2605312330); consumables (wire, slurry, coolant) + the consumed polysilicon lot

qaMetrologyCid.description: content-addressed wafer metrology bundle (resistivity / minority-carrier lifetime / total-thickness-variation / microcrack inspection)

processParametersCid.description: G1: open process parameters for this batch (growth pull-rate, thermal profile, wire feed); content-addressed

attestingEngineerDid.description: DID of the PV-process engineer attesting this batch (Council technical-advisory member at R1 activation)

attestingRobots.description: Ed25519 robot witness quorum (>=2 distinct robots) over the slicing QA + mass-balance bundle

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human QA tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

role.description: witness role (e.g. metrology / wire-saw / mass-balance / microcrack-inspection)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested batch bundle
